decision_conditions: Reason : 1 - The proposed first floor rear extension, by reason of its excessive width, eaves height and position close to the boundaries of the site, would be an intrusive and unneighbourly addition, out of scale and character with this and surrounding dwellings, as well as having a serious and adverse effect on the amenities enjoyed by the occupants of neighbouring properties causing loss of light, outlook and overbearing sense of enclosure and visual amenities of the locality. Thus, it is contrary to Residential Extension Guidelines, Local Plan policies SC7, CC1, CC2 and CC4 of Local Plan, London Plan policies of HC1, D4 and the National Planning Policy Framework.

Reason : 2 - The proposed first floor rear balustrade, by reason of its position and appearance, would be out of scale and character with this and surrounding dwellings, as well as having an adverse effect on the visual amenities of the locality. Thus, it is contrary to Residential Extension Guidelines, Local Plan policies SC7, CC1, CC2 and CC4 of Local Plan, London Plan policies of HC1, D4 and the National Planning Policy Framework.
description: First floor partial rear extension. Remodelled rear dormer window. Alteration to side dormer windows.
application_type_full: Householder planning & demolition in a conservation area
